findings.title: Eager registered compounds escape field-navigation separators and admit partial identities
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, no AHK execution: enable personal-info expansion and supported pattern_max_length=2; n=last_name LEFT,p=first_name RIGHT; from fresh boundary type @np+MagicKey. Registered Generate stores LEFT{{}Tab{}}RIGHT with OnlyText=false while preview advertises LEFT ⇥ RIGHT; max1 transient control stores LEFT{Tab}RIGHT. Clear last_name through editor: eager @np registers RIGHT, while transient and preview decline whole empty-field combo.
findings.root_cause: Generate joins raw fields using {Tab}, then SendEscapeLiteral on whole aggregate escapes intended navigation; its only aggregate nonempty check also allows missing/empty parts. Per-value/all-or-nothing transient resolver has correct semantics but registered specs take precedence.
findings.silent_failure: Valid registered spec succeeds and private logging works; no error/refusal indicates the wrong literal separator or shifted partial identity. Frozen PreviewFields/Values advertise separate fields rather than the eager Send payload.
findings.regression_test: Actual eager registration versus actual transient resolver with max1/max2, first/middle/last empty/missing fields, repeats, Unicode/literal braces/metacharacters. Assert exact escaped values plus unescaped interfield Tab only and whole-combo refusal. Preserve privacy/decision snapshots; verify native form placement separately.

findings.title: Valid TOML known personal fields silently load as placeholders
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, no AHK execution: public open_personal_info opens file in Notepad; change known first_name to valid literal-string assignment first_name = 'SYNTHETIC', save/reload. Windows double-quoted-only regex ignores it, retains placeholder, marks exact source admitted, with no diagnostic; double-quoted healthy control loads. Quoted known key likewise omitted. Actual shared Lua codec decodes all3 equally. Subsequent explicit form Save may overwrite source with displayed placeholder; that save is authorized, not a source-consent bypass.
findings.root_cause: ReadPersonalInfoToml combines raw-byte source admission with partial line regex requiring bare word keys and double-quoted values. Unsupported valid known-field syntax is treated as missing, inherits opening defaults and is cached as an admitted model/source.
findings.silent_failure: No branch diagnoses unmatched valid known fields and no unreadable latch is set. Source receipt guards byte equality and current form/model, not whether known values decoded; insertion can emit placeholder and an authorized form rewrite can lose original literal value.
findings.regression_test: Actual reader->editor model->private save/reload/insertion on equivalent basic/literal/quoted-key/Unicode field and alias spellings; preserve values or loudly refuse unsupported source without certifying defaults. Separate bad load from later authorized Save, preserve no-read/no-write/source/path/session/generation safeguards.
